name: ArenaStatDelta
description: How a metric moved. Preformatted: ArenaStatCard never formats. The pill's colour says whether the change was GOOD, not which way it points, which is why direction and tone are separate fields.

direction.description: Which way the number moved. Draws the arrow: nothing else.

tone.description: Whether that movement is GOOD. Defaults to neutral: an unlabelled delta claims nothing.
